<!-- phd-intelligence-action-center-v1 -->

This issue accepts owner-only \`/workspace\` commands for confirmed public application status updates. Only the repository owner can trigger the update workflow.

**Never put private applicant information, email content, receipt links, API keys, or personal notes in this public issue.** Private state belongs in the local runtime. For an issue-specific link, set the \`PHD_ATLAS_ACTION_ISSUE\` GitHub Actions repository variable to the created issue number, then rerun the Pages workflow.
